name: carry_bags
text: Standing still carrying one heavy shopping bag in each hand. Both arms are straight down by the sides, both hands remain below the hips throughout. Relax the shoulders downward under the weight. Slightly shift weight from one leg to the other without walking or raising either hand.

review.notes_zh: 双手低位提袋站立，手略在髋前；用走路提袋参考姿态约束双臂，手距约58厘米。固定放松手指，不宣称闭合握柄。
